Method of Attack: Information-stealing malware operations abusing an undocumented Google Chrome OAuth MultiLogin API endpoint to generate new authentication cookies when previously stolen ones have expired
Stealing multiple tokens from Google Chrome including authentication cookies and a special Refresh token to generate new authentication tokens
Loading stolen cookies into threat actors' browsers to gain access to infected users' Google accounts
Attack Vector: Malware stealing authentication cookies and tokens from infected users' Google Chrome browsers
Indicators of Compromise: Use of stolen and refreshed Google authentication cookies
Abuse of Google OAuth MultiLogin API endpoint
Stolen credentials used to access Google accounts
Notification of compromised accounts by Google
Example incident involving Orange España's RIPE account compromise via stolen credentials
